data.long_meaning: The name Jaz is derived from the Greek name Iasous, which means 'God heals'. In the New Testament, this name is given to several characters, including one of the three Magi who visited the baby Jesus. The name Jaz carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jaz usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
